Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-1 (non-medical) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Research Scientist-1 (non-medical) position at AIIMS Bhopal is scheduled for 30 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Project Research Scientist-1 (non-medical) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Post Graduate Degree including integrated PG degrees in clinical psychology, or a Second Class Post Graduate Degree with a PhD in clinical psychology to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist-1 (non-medical) post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided to SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 56,000 to Rs. 67,200, which includes a basic salary and House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist-1 (non-medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-1 (non-medical) position at AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-1 (non-medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are advised to bring all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, 462020. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Project Research Scientist-1 (non-medical) post is on a contractual basis.
